name: 10977 · Spring Valley, NY
findings: ZIP 10977 (Spring Valley) has 553 nonprofit organizations. 112 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (51% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10977 (Spring Valley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10977 (Spring Valley) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
